runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated poteto-mode/interrogate Skills and reviewer/synthesizer TOML files committed in a disposable Git fixture; isolated CODEX_HOME; custom-role selector unavailable, so role contracts were supplied inline.
runtime.permissionProfile: workspace-write sandbox with read-only delegated contracts and automatic approval review

assertions.evidence: The root loaded repository-generated Skills and role definitions; unrelated configured MCP startup failures did not participate.
The root loaded poteto-mode and selected interrogate for the requested bounded architecture review.
The root read and hashed all three files before delegation.
Exactly two reviewer sessions were started before the first explicit wait.
The initial assignments referred to a tool-output packet that the child sessions did not receive; reviewer 1 later received the packet directly while reviewer 2 remained incomplete.
Reviewer 2 produced an indeterminate incomplete review, and reviewer 1 was repaired with a later direct message, violating the initial-result boundary.
Both reviewer sessions remained read-only and the disposable repository stayed clean.
Exactly one synthesizer was started after the two imperfect reviewer results were frozen.
The synthesizer and final response distinguish reviewer 1's repaired complete result from reviewer 2's indeterminate result.
The complete reviewer, synthesizer, and root selected durable-log without fabricating two-reviewer consensus.
The root reread, rehashed, ran node verify.mjs durable-log successfully, checked clean Git, and independently selected durable-log.
The root disclosed the inline generated-role fallback and explicitly reported the failed packet transport rather than hiding it.
Root and external checks found no repository changes.
No commit, push, pull request, or publication occurred.

limitations: This failed run motivated the fixture rule requiring the complete literal packet in both initial spawn assignments and forbidding later repair.
Unrelated Cloudflare MCP authentication warnings and macOS sandbox cache diagnostics did not participate in the workflow.
